### 5.C.1) PERMANOVA 
```{r}
cat(paste0("STEP 5.C.1) PERMANOVA using ", GROUPING_VAR, ".\n"),
file = LOGS_FILE, append = TRUE)


#########################################################
### 0. Define PERMANOVA configuration
#########################################################
#Primary variable to test.
PERMANOVA_VARIABLES <- GROUPING_VAR

#Additional variable(s) to adjust for.
PERMANOVA_COVARIATES <- COVARIATES

#Number of permutations.
PERMANOVA_PERMUTATIONS <- 900

#########################
## Output directory name.
#########################
PERMANOVA_DIR <- file.path(
  OUTPUT_DIR,
  "PERMANOVA"
)

PERMANOVA_TABLES_DIR <- file.path(
  PERMANOVA_DIR,
  "tables"
)

dir.create(
  PERMANOVA_TABLES_DIR,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

#Combine model variables and remove duplicates.
PERMANOVA_MODEL_VARIABLES <- unique(c(
  PERMANOVA_VARIABLES,
  PERMANOVA_COVARIATES
))

#Validate configuration.
if (length(PERMANOVA_VARIABLES) == 0) {
  stop("ERROR: Define at least one primary PERMANOVA variable.")
}

if (anyDuplicated(PERMANOVA_VARIABLES)) {
  stop("ERROR: Duplicate primary PERMANOVA variables.")
}

if (any(PERMANOVA_VARIABLES %in% PERMANOVA_COVARIATES)) {
  stop(
    "ERROR: Primary variables and adjustment variables must not overlap."
  )
}

if (length(PERMANOVA_PERMUTATIONS) != 1 ||
    is.na(PERMANOVA_PERMUTATIONS) ||
    !is.finite(PERMANOVA_PERMUTATIONS) ||
    PERMANOVA_PERMUTATIONS < 1 ||
    PERMANOVA_PERMUTATIONS != floor(PERMANOVA_PERMUTATIONS)) {
  stop("ERROR: PERMANOVA_PERMUTATIONS must be a positive integer.")
}

if (!"SampleID" %in% colnames(regular_metadata)) {
  stop("ERROR: regular_metadata must contain a SampleID column.")
}

missing_variables <- setdiff(
  PERMANOVA_MODEL_VARIABLES,
  colnames(regular_metadata)
)

if (length(missing_variables) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "ERROR: PERMANOVA metadata variables not found:",
      paste(missing_variables, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

cat(
  paste0(
    "Primary PERMANOVA variable(s): ",
    paste(PERMANOVA_VARIABLES, collapse = ", "), "\n",
    "Adjustment variable(s): ",
    if (length(PERMANOVA_COVARIATES) > 0) {
      paste(PERMANOVA_COVARIATES, collapse = ", ")
    } else {
      "None"
    },
    "\n",
    "Number of permutations: ",
    PERMANOVA_PERMUTATIONS, "\n"
  ),
  file = LOGS_FILE,
  append = TRUE
)


#########################################################
### 1. Prepare metadata
#########################################################
permanova_metadata <- regular_metadata %>%
  dplyr::select(
    SampleID,
    dplyr::all_of(PERMANOVA_MODEL_VARIABLES)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::where(is.character),
      trimws
    )
  )

#Convert empty character values to NA.
for (v in PERMANOVA_MODEL_VARIABLES) {
  if (is.character(permanova_metadata[[v]])) {
    permanova_metadata[[v]][
      permanova_metadata[[v]] == ""
    ] <- NA_character_
  }
}

#Remove samples with missing SampleID.
if (anyNA(permanova_metadata$SampleID) ||
    any(permanova_metadata$SampleID == "")) {
  stop("ERROR: Missing or empty SampleID values in metadata.")
}

#Each sample must occur only once.
if (anyDuplicated(permanova_metadata$SampleID)) {
  stop("ERROR: Duplicate SampleID values found in metadata.")
}

#Primary grouping variables are treated as categorical.
for (v in PERMANOVA_VARIABLES) {
  permanova_metadata[[v]] <- factor(
    permanova_metadata[[v]]
  )
}

#Character covariates are categorical.
#Numeric covariates, such as age, remain numeric.
for (v in PERMANOVA_COVARIATES) {
  if (is.character(permanova_metadata[[v]])) {
    permanova_metadata[[v]] <- factor(
      permanova_metadata[[v]]
    )
  }
}

#Exclude samples missing any model variable.
valid_rows <- complete.cases(
  permanova_metadata[
    ,
    PERMANOVA_MODEL_VARIABLES,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)

#Also exclude non-finite numeric values.
for (v in PERMANOVA_MODEL_VARIABLES) {
  if (is.numeric(permanova_metadata[[v]])) {
    valid_rows <- valid_rows &
      is.finite(permanova_metadata[[v]])
  }
}

permanova_metadata <- permanova_metadata[
  valid_rows,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

#Remove unused factor levels.
permanova_metadata <- droplevels(permanova_metadata)

if (nrow(permanova_metadata) < 3) {
  stop("ERROR: Fewer than three complete metadata samples remain.")}

#Validate primary grouping variables.
for (v in PERMANOVA_VARIABLES) {
  if (nlevels(permanova_metadata[[v]]) < 2) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "ERROR: Primary variable", v,
        "has fewer than two observed groups."
      ))}}

#Validate categorical adjustment variables.
for (v in PERMANOVA_COVARIATES) {
  if (is.factor(permanova_metadata[[v]]) &&
      nlevels(permanova_metadata[[v]]) < 2) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "ERROR: Adjustment variable", v,
        "has fewer than two observed groups."
      ))}}

cat("\nPrimary-variable sample counts:\n")

for (v in PERMANOVA_VARIABLES) {
  cat("\n", v, ":\n", sep = "")
  print(table(permanova_metadata[[v]], useNA = "ifany"))}

for (v in PERMANOVA_COVARIATES) {
  cat("\nAdjustment variable:", v, "\n")
  print(summary(permanova_metadata[[v]]))}

cat(
  paste0("Complete metadata samples available: ", nrow(permanova_metadata), "\n"),
  file = LOGS_FILE,
  append = TRUE)


#########################################################
### 2. Define available distance matrices
#########################################################
permanova_distances <- list()

#Bray-Curtis: genus level
if (exists("bray_curtis_genus_matrix")) {
  permanova_distances[["Bray-Curtis (Genus)"]] <-
    bray_curtis_genus_matrix
} else if (exists("bray_curtis_matrix")) {
  permanova_distances[["Bray-Curtis (Genus)"]] <-
    bray_curtis_matrix
}

#Bray-Curtis: ASV level
if (exists("bray_curtis_asv_matrix")) {
  permanova_distances[["Bray-Curtis (ASV)"]] <-
    bray_curtis_asv_matrix
}

#Jaccard: genus level
if (exists("jaccard_genus_matrix")) {
  permanova_distances[["Jaccard (Genus)"]] <-
    jaccard_genus_matrix
} else if (exists("jaccard_matrix")) {
  permanova_distances[["Jaccard (Genus)"]] <-
    jaccard_matrix
}

#Jaccard: ASV level
if (exists("jaccard_asv_matrix")) {
  permanova_distances[["Jaccard (ASV)"]] <-
    jaccard_asv_matrix
}

#Weighted UniFrac: ASV level
if (exists("weighted_unifrac_matrix")) {
  permanova_distances[["Weighted UniFrac (ASV)"]] <-
    weighted_unifrac_matrix
}

#Unweighted UniFrac: ASV level
if (exists("unweighted_unifrac_matrix")) {
  permanova_distances[["Unweighted UniFrac (ASV)"]] <-
    unweighted_unifrac_matrix
}

if (length(permanova_distances) == 0) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "ERROR: No distance matrices found in the current",
      "R session. Create the distance matrices first and",
      "check their object names."
    )
  )
}

cat("\nDistance matrices available for PERMANOVA:\n")
print(names(permanova_distances))


#########################################################
### 3. Function to run adjusted PERMANOVA
#########################################################
run_permanova <- function(
    distance_matrix,
    distance_name,
    metadata_df,
    variables,
    covariates = character(0),
    permutations = 999
) {
  model_variables <- unique(c(variables, covariates))

  distance_matrix <- as.matrix(distance_matrix)

  #Validate distance matrix dimensions.
  if (nrow(distance_matrix) != ncol(distance_matrix)) {
    stop(
      paste("ERROR: Non-square distance matrix:", distance_name)
    )
  }

  if (is.null(rownames(distance_matrix)) ||
      is.null(colnames(distance_matrix))) {
    stop(
      paste("ERROR: Missing sample names in:", distance_name)
    )
  }

  if (anyDuplicated(rownames(distance_matrix)) ||
      anyDuplicated(colnames(distance_matrix))) {
    stop(
      paste("ERROR: Duplicate sample names in:", distance_name)
    )
  }

  if (!setequal(
    rownames(distance_matrix),
    colnames(distance_matrix)
  )) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "ERROR: Row and column sample IDs differ in:",
        distance_name
      )
    )
  }

  #Align columns with rows.
  distance_matrix <- distance_matrix[
    ,
    rownames(distance_matrix),
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  #Match samples present in both datasets.
  common_samples <- rownames(distance_matrix)[
    rownames(distance_matrix) %in% metadata_df$SampleID
  ]

  if (length(common_samples) < 3) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "ERROR: Fewer than three shared samples for",
        distance_name
      )
    )
  }

  #Subset and align metadata.
  distance_sub <- distance_matrix[
    common_samples,
    common_samples,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  metadata_sub <- metadata_df[
    match(common_samples, metadata_df$SampleID),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  #Ensure that all model variables are complete.
  keep <- complete.cases(
    metadata_sub[, model_variables, drop = FALSE]
  )

  for (v in model_variables) {
    if (is.numeric(metadata_sub[[v]])) {
      keep <- keep & is.finite(metadata_sub[[v]])
    }
  }

  metadata_sub <- metadata_sub[keep, , drop = FALSE]

  distance_sub <- distance_sub[
    keep,
    keep,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (nrow(metadata_sub) < 3) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "ERROR: Fewer than three complete samples for",
        distance_name
      )
    )
  }

  metadata_sub <- droplevels(metadata_sub)

  #Recheck primary variables after sample filtering.
  for (v in variables) {
    if (length(unique(metadata_sub[[v]])) < 2) {
      stop(
        paste(
          "ERROR: Fewer than two groups remain for",
          v, "in", distance_name
        )
      )
    }
  }

  #Recheck categorical covariates.
  for (v in covariates) {
    if (is.factor(metadata_sub[[v]]) &&
        nlevels(metadata_sub[[v]]) < 2) {
      stop(
        paste(
          "ERROR: Adjustment variable", v,
          "has fewer than two groups in", distance_name
        )
      )
    }
  }

  #Validate distances.
  if (any(!is.finite(distance_sub))) {
    stop(
      paste("ERROR: Non-finite distances in:", distance_name)
    )
  }

  if (any(distance_sub < -1e-8)) {
    stop(
      paste("ERROR: Negative distances in:", distance_name)
    )
  }

  if (!isTRUE(all.equal(
    distance_sub,
    t(distance_sub),
    tolerance = 1e-8
  ))) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "ERROR: Distance matrix is not symmetric:",
        distance_name
      )
    )
  }

  if (any(abs(diag(distance_sub)) > 1e-8)) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "ERROR: Non-zero diagonal distances in:",
        distance_name
      )
    )
  }

  distance_object <- stats::as.dist(distance_sub)

  #Build the multivariable model.
  model_formula <- stats::reformulate(
    termlabels = model_variables,
    response = "distance_object"
  )

  result <- vegan::adonis2(
    model_formula,
    data = metadata_sub,
    permutations = permutations,
    by = "margin"
  )

  #Convert results to a data frame.
  result_df <- as.data.frame(result)

  result_df$Term <- rownames(result_df)
  rownames(result_df) <- NULL

  result_df$Distance <- distance_name

  result_df$Primary_variables <- paste(
    variables,
    collapse = ", "
  )

  result_df$Adjustment_variables <- if (
    length(covariates) > 0
  ) {
    paste(covariates, collapse = ", ")
  } else {
    "None"
  }

  result_df$N_samples <- nrow(metadata_sub)

  result_df$Permutations <- permutations

  result_df <- result_df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Distance,
      Primary_variables,
      Adjustment_variables,
      Term,
      N_samples,
      Permutations,
      dplyr::everything()
    )

  list(
    result = result,
    table = result_df,
    metadata = metadata_sub,
    distance = distance_object
  )
}


#########################################################
### 4. Run PERMANOVA for every available distance matrix
#########################################################
permanova_results_list <- list()
permanova_tables_list <- list()

for (distance_name in names(permanova_distances)) {
  cat(
    "\nRunning adjusted PERMANOVA for",
    distance_name,
    "...\n"
  )

  analysis <- tryCatch(
    run_permanova(
      distance_matrix = permanova_distances[[distance_name]],
      distance_name = distance_name,
      metadata_df = permanova_metadata,
      variables = PERMANOVA_VARIABLES,
      covariates = PERMANOVA_COVARIATES,
      permutations = PERMANOVA_PERMUTATIONS
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      cat(
        "ERROR for ",
        distance_name,
        ": ",
        conditionMessage(e),
        "\n",
        sep = "",
        file = LOGS_FILE,
        append = TRUE
      )

      warning(
        paste(
          "Skipping",
          distance_name,
          ":",
          conditionMessage(e)
        )
      )

      NULL
    }
  )

  if (!is.null(analysis)) {
    result_key <- gsub(
      "[^A-Za-z0-9]+",
      "_",
      distance_name
    )

    permanova_results_list[[result_key]] <-
      analysis$result

    permanova_tables_list[[result_key]] <-
      analysis$table

    cat("\nResults:", distance_name, "\n")
    print(analysis$result)

    #Save individual result table.
    write.table(
      analysis$table,
      file = file.path(
        PERMANOVA_TABLES_DIR,
        paste0(
          "PERMANOVA_",
          result_key,
          ".tsv"
        )
      ),
      sep = "\t",
      quote = FALSE,
      row.names = FALSE
    )}}

if (length(permanova_tables_list) == 0) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "ERROR: No PERMANOVA analyses completed successfully.",
      "Review the warnings and log."
    ))}


#########################################################
### 5. Combine and save results
#########################################################
permanova_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  permanova_tables_list)

write.table(
  permanova_results,
  file = file.path(
    PERMANOVA_TABLES_DIR,
    "PERMANOVA_results.tsv"
  ),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nCombined adjusted PERMANOVA results:\n")
print(permanova_results)

cat(
  "\nCombined PERMANOVA results saved to:\n",
  file.path(
    PERMANOVA_TABLES_DIR,
    "PERMANOVA_results.tsv"
  ),
  "\n",
  file = LOGS_FILE,
  append = TRUE)


#########################################################
### 6. Logs
#########################################################
cat("PERMANOVA analyses completed.\n",
file = LOGS_FILE, append = TRUE)

cat("PERMANOVA tables saved to:\n", PERMANOVA_TABLES_DIR, "\n",
file = LOGS_FILE, append = TRUE)

cat("FINISHED STEP 5.C.1) PERMANOVA.\n",
file = LOGS_FILE, append = TRUE)
```

##### A) Plot results from PERMANOVA
```{r}
cat("STEP A) Plotting adjusted PERMANOVA results.\n",
file = LOGS_FILE, append = TRUE)


#########################################################
### 1. Define plotting configuration
#########################################################
#These should match the variables used in the PERMANOVA.

PLOT_PRIMARY_VARIABLE <- GROUPING_VAR

PLOT_COVARIATES <- COVARIATES


#########################################################
### 2. Load combined PERMANOVA results
#########################################################
PERMANOVA_RESULTS_FILE <- file.path(
  OUTPUT_DIR,
  "PERMANOVA",
  "tables",
  "PERMANOVA_results.tsv")

if (!file.exists(PERMANOVA_RESULTS_FILE)) {
  stop(
    "PERMANOVA results file not found: ",
    PERMANOVA_RESULTS_FILE)}

permanova_results <- read.delim(
  PERMANOVA_RESULTS_FILE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


#########################################################
### 3. Validate results columns
#########################################################
required_columns <- c(
  "Distance",
  "Primary_variables",
  "Adjustment_variables",
  "Term",
  "R2",
  "Pr(>F)")

missing_columns <- setdiff(
  required_columns,
  colnames(permanova_results))

if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "Missing columns in PERMANOVA results:",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "),
      ". Rerun the corrected PERMANOVA analysis first."
    ))}


#########################################################
### 4. Select the adjusted effect of interest
#########################################################
expected_covariates <- if (length(PLOT_COVARIATES) > 0) {
  paste(PLOT_COVARIATES, collapse = ", ")
} else {
  "None"}

permanova_plot_data <- permanova_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Primary_variables == PLOT_PRIMARY_VARIABLE,
    Adjustment_variables == expected_covariates,
    Term == PLOT_PRIMARY_VARIABLE,
    !is.na(R2),
    !is.na(`Pr(>F)`)
  )

if (nrow(permanova_plot_data) == 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "No valid adjusted PERMANOVA results found for ",
      PLOT_PRIMARY_VARIABLE,
      " adjusted for ",
      expected_covariates,
      ". Check the results table and model terms."
    )
  )
}


#########################################################
### 5. Define plotting order and significance
#########################################################
distance_order <- c(
  "Bray-Curtis (Genus)",
  "Bray-Curtis (ASV)",
  "Jaccard (Genus)",
  "Jaccard (ASV)",
  "Weighted UniFrac (ASV)",
  "Unweighted UniFrac (ASV)"
)

#Retain the configured order and include any other
#distance metrics present in the results.
observed_distances <- unique(
  permanova_plot_data$Distance
)

distance_levels <- c(
  distance_order[distance_order %in% observed_distances],
  setdiff(observed_distances, distance_order)
)

permanova_plot_data <- permanova_plot_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Distance = factor(
      Distance,
      levels = distance_levels
    ),
    Significance = dplyr::case_when(
      `Pr(>F)` < 0.001 ~ "***",
      `Pr(>F)` < 0.01  ~ "**",
      `Pr(>F)` < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    ),
    P_value_label = paste0(
      "p = ",
      format.pval(
        `Pr(>F)`,
        digits = 3,
        eps = 0.001
      )
    ),
    Plot_label = paste0(
      Significance,
      "\n",
      P_value_label
    )
  )


#########################################################
### 6. Create adjusted PERMANOVA plot
#########################################################
covariate_title <- if (length(PLOT_COVARIATES) > 0) {
  paste(
    "adjusted for",
    paste(PLOT_COVARIATES, collapse = ", ")
  )
} else {
  "unadjusted"
}

p_permanova <- ggplot(
  permanova_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = Distance,
    y = R2,
    fill = Distance
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.7,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Plot_label),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 3.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(
    option = "viridis"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(
      accuracy = 0.1
    ),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0, 0.22)
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste(
      "PERMANOVA:",
      PLOT_PRIMARY_VARIABLE,
      covariate_title
    ),
    subtitle = "Marginal R-squared and permutation p-values",
    x = "Distance metric",
    y = expression(R^2 ~ "(marginal variation explained)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 35,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )


#########################################################
### 7. Display plot
#########################################################
print(p_permanova)


#########################################################
### 8. Save plot
#########################################################

  OUTPUT_DIR,
  "PERMANOVA",
  "figures"
)

dir.create(
  PERMANOVA_FIGURES_DIR,
  recursive = TRUE,

)

  length(PLOT_COVARIATES) > 0
) {
  paste0(
    "_adjusted_for_",
    paste(PLOT_COVARIATES, collapse = "_")
  )
} else {
  "_unadjusted"
}

PLOT_FILENAME <- paste0(
  "PERMANOVA_",
  PLOT_PRIMARY_VARIABLE,
  PLOT_COVARIATE_SUFFIX,
  "_R2.png")

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
```

### 5.C.2) PERMADISP
```{r}
cat(paste0("STEP 5.C.2) PERMDISP using ", GROUPING_VAR, ".\n"),
file = LOGS_FILE, append = TRUE)


#########################################################
### 0. Define PERMDISP configuration
#########################################################
#Primary variable to test for.
PERMDISP_VARIABLE <- GROUPING_VAR

#Number of permutations.
PERMDISP_PERMUTATIONS <- 999

#Use spatial medians for group centers.
PERMDISP_CENTER <- "median"

#Bias adjustment for unequal group sizes.
PERMDISP_BIAS_ADJUST <- TRUE


#########################################################
### 1. Create output directories
#########################################################
PERMDISP_DIR <- file.path(
  OUTPUT_DIR,
  "PERMDISP"
)

PERMDISP_FIGURES_DIR <- file.path(
  PERMDISP_DIR,
  "figures"
)

PERMDISP_TABLES_DIR <- file.path(
  PERMDISP_DIR,
  "tables"
)

dir.create(
  PERMDISP_FIGURES_DIR,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

dir.create(
  PERMDISP_TABLES_DIR,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


#########################################################
### 2. Validate configuration and prepare metadata
#########################################################
if (!is.numeric(PERMDISP_PERMUTATIONS) ||
    length(PERMDISP_PERMUTATIONS) != 1 ||
    is.na(PERMDISP_PERMUTATIONS) ||
    !is.finite(PERMDISP_PERMUTATIONS) ||
    PERMDISP_PERMUTATIONS < 1 ||
    PERMDISP_PERMUTATIONS != floor(PERMDISP_PERMUTATIONS)) {
  stop("ERROR: PERMDISP_PERMUTATIONS must be a positive integer.")
}

if (!PERMDISP_CENTER %in% c("centroid", "median")) {
  stop("ERROR: PERMDISP_CENTER must be 'centroid' or 'median'.")
}

if (!"SampleID" %in% colnames(regular_metadata)) {
  stop("ERROR: regular_metadata must contain a SampleID column.")
}

if (!PERMDISP_VARIABLE %in% colnames(regular_metadata)) {
  stop(
    "ERROR: Metadata variable '",
    PERMDISP_VARIABLE,
    "' was not found."
  )
}

permdisp_metadata <- regular_metadata %>%
  dplyr::select(
    SampleID,
    dplyr::all_of(PERMDISP_VARIABLE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    SampleID = as.character(SampleID)
  )

#Trim whitespace from character metadata.
if (is.character(permdisp_metadata[[PERMDISP_VARIABLE]])) {
  permdisp_metadata[[PERMDISP_VARIABLE]] <- trimws(
    permdisp_metadata[[PERMDISP_VARIABLE]]
  )
}

#Remove missing and empty values.
valid_rows <- !is.na(permdisp_metadata$SampleID) &
  permdisp_metadata$SampleID != "" &
  !is.na(permdisp_metadata[[PERMDISP_VARIABLE]])

if (is.character(permdisp_metadata[[PERMDISP_VARIABLE]])) {
  valid_rows <- valid_rows &
    permdisp_metadata[[PERMDISP_VARIABLE]] != ""
}

permdisp_metadata <- permdisp_metadata[
  valid_rows,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

#Each sample must occur only once.
if (anyDuplicated(permdisp_metadata$SampleID)) {
  stop("ERROR: Duplicate SampleID values in metadata.")
}

permdisp_metadata[[PERMDISP_VARIABLE]] <- droplevels(
  factor(permdisp_metadata[[PERMDISP_VARIABLE]])
)

if (nlevels(permdisp_metadata[[PERMDISP_VARIABLE]]) < 2) {
  stop(
    "ERROR: PERMDISP requires at least two observed groups."
  )
}

cat(
  paste0(
    "PERMDISP grouping variable: ",
    PERMDISP_VARIABLE, "\n",
    "PERMDISP center: ",
    PERMDISP_CENTER, "\n",
    "Bias adjustment: ",
    PERMDISP_BIAS_ADJUST, "\n",
    "Number of permutations: ",
    PERMDISP_PERMUTATIONS, "\n"
  ),
  file = LOGS_FILE,
  append = TRUE
)

cat("\nSample counts by group:\n")
print(table(permdisp_metadata[[PERMDISP_VARIABLE]], useNA = "ifany"))

capture.output(
  print(table(permdisp_metadata[[PERMDISP_VARIABLE]], useNA = "ifany")),
  file = LOGS_FILE,
  append = TRUE
)


#########################################################
### 3. Obtain available distance matrices
#########################################################
permdisp_distances <- list()

if (exists("permanova_distances") &&
    is.list(permanova_distances) &&
    length(permanova_distances) > 0) {

  permdisp_distances <- permanova_distances

} else {

  PERMDISP_DISTANCE_FILES <- c(
    "Bray-Curtis (Genus)" = file.path(
      TABLES_DIR,
      "Bray_Curtis_genus_distance_matrix.tsv"
    ),
    "Bray-Curtis (ASV)" = file.path(
      TABLES_DIR,
      "Bray_Curtis_ASV_distance_matrix.tsv"
    ),
    "Jaccard (Genus)" = file.path(
      TABLES_DIR,
      "Jaccard_genus_distance_matrix.tsv"
    ),
    "Jaccard (ASV)" = file.path(
      TABLES_DIR,
      "Jaccard_ASV_distance_matrix.tsv"
    ),
    "Weighted UniFrac (ASV)" = file.path(
      TABLES_DIR,
      "Weighted_UniFrac_ASV_distance_matrix.tsv"
    ),
    "Unweighted UniFrac (ASV)" = file.path(
      TABLES_DIR,
      "Unweighted_UniFrac_ASV_distance_matrix.tsv"
    )
  )

  for (distance_name in names(PERMDISP_DISTANCE_FILES)) {

    distance_file <- PERMDISP_DISTANCE_FILES[[distance_name]]

    if (!file.exists(distance_file)) {
      cat(
        "Distance matrix not found; skipping: ",
        distance_file, "\n",
        sep = "",
        file = LOGS_FILE,
        append = TRUE
      )
      next
    }

    distance_matrix <- as.matrix(
      read.delim(
        distance_file,
        row.names = 1,
        check.names = FALSE
      )
    )

    storage.mode(distance_matrix) <- "numeric"

    permdisp_distances[[distance_name]] <- distance_matrix
  }
}

if (length(permdisp_distances) == 0) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "ERROR: No distance matrices available for PERMDISP.",
      "Create the matrices or check the TSV file paths."
    )
  )
}

cat("\nDistance matrices available for PERMDISP:\n")
print(names(permdisp_distances))


#########################################################
### 4. Function to run PERMDISP
#########################################################
run_permdisp <- function(
    distance_matrix,
    distance_name,
    metadata_df,
    variable,
    permutations = 999,
    center = "median",
    bias_adjust = TRUE
) {
  distance_matrix <- as.matrix(distance_matrix)

  #Validate matrix dimensions and sample identifiers.
  if (nrow(distance_matrix) != ncol(distance_matrix)) {
    stop(
      paste("ERROR: Non-square distance matrix:", distance_name)
    )
  }

  if (is.null(rownames(distance_matrix)) ||
      is.null(colnames(distance_matrix))) {
    stop(
      paste("ERROR: Missing sample names in:", distance_name)
    )
  }

  if (anyDuplicated(rownames(distance_matrix)) ||
      anyDuplicated(colnames(distance_matrix))) {
    stop(
      paste("ERROR: Duplicate sample names in:", distance_name)
    )
  }

  if (!setequal(
    rownames(distance_matrix),
    colnames(distance_matrix)
  )) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "ERROR: Row and column sample IDs differ in:",
        distance_name
      )
    )
  }

  #Align columns with rows.
  distance_matrix <- distance_matrix[
    ,
    rownames(distance_matrix),
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  #Validate distance values.
  if (any(!is.finite(distance_matrix))) {
    stop(
      paste("ERROR: Non-finite distances in:", distance_name)
    )
  }

  if (any(distance_matrix < -1e-8)) {
    stop(
      paste("ERROR: Negative distances in:", distance_name)
    )
  }

  if (!isTRUE(all.equal(
    distance_matrix,
    t(distance_matrix),
    tolerance = 1e-8
  ))) {
    stop(
      paste("ERROR: Distance matrix is not symmetric:", distance_name)
    )
  }

  if (any(abs(diag(distance_matrix)) > 1e-8)) {
    stop(
      paste("ERROR: Non-zero diagonal in:", distance_name)
    )
  }

  #Identify shared samples.
  common_samples <- rownames(distance_matrix)[
    rownames(distance_matrix) %in% metadata_df$SampleID
  ]

  if (length(common_samples) < 3) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "ERROR: Fewer than three shared samples for:",
        distance_name
      )
    )
  }

  #Align metadata and distance matrix.
  metadata_sub <- metadata_df[
    match(common_samples, metadata_df$SampleID),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  distance_sub <- distance_matrix[
    common_samples,
    common_samples,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  metadata_sub[[variable]] <- droplevels(
    factor(metadata_sub[[variable]])
  )

  #Check the number of groups.
  if (nlevels(metadata_sub[[variable]]) < 2) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "ERROR: Fewer than two groups remain for:",
        distance_name
      )
    )
  }

  group_counts <- table(metadata_sub[[variable]])

  #Bias adjustment requires sufficient observations per group.
  if (bias_adjust && any(group_counts < 2)) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "ERROR: Bias adjustment requires at least two samples",
        "in every group for:", distance_name
      )
    )
  }

  if (any(group_counts < 2)) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "ERROR: At least two samples per group are required",
        "for this PERMDISP analysis:", distance_name
      )
    )
  }

  #Convert to a distance object.
  distance_object <- stats::as.dist(distance_sub)

  #Calculate distances to group centers.
  dispersion_model <- vegan::betadisper(
    distance_object,
    group = metadata_sub[[variable]],
    type = center,
    bias.adjust = bias_adjust
  )

  #Permutation test.
  dispersion_test <- vegan::permutest(
    dispersion_model,
    permutations = permutations
  )

  #Extract the group effect.
  test_table <- as.data.frame(dispersion_test$tab)

  if (!"Groups" %in% rownames(test_table)) {
    stop(
      paste("ERROR: Groups test not found for:", distance_name)
    )
  }

  group_row <- test_table["Groups", , drop = FALSE]

  results <- data.frame(
    Distance = distance_name,
    Variable = variable,
    Term = "Groups",
    N_samples = length(common_samples),
    N_groups = nlevels(metadata_sub[[variable]]),
    Permutations = permutations,
    Center = center,
    Bias_adjust = bias_adjust,
    Df = group_row$Df,
    SumOfSqs = group_row[["Sum Sq"]],
    Mean_Sq = group_row[["Mean Sq"]],
    F = group_row$F,
    `Pr(>F)` = group_row[["Pr(>F)"]],
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  #Per-sample distances to group centers.
  dispersion_data <- data.frame(
    SampleID = common_samples,
    Distance_to_Center = as.numeric(
      dispersion_model$distances
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  dispersion_data <- dplyr::left_join(
    dispersion_data,
    metadata_sub,
    by = "SampleID"
  )

  dispersion_data$Distance <- distance_name

  list(
    model = dispersion_model,
    test = dispersion_test,
    results = results,
    dispersion_data = dispersion_data
  )
}


#########################################################
### 5. Run PERMDISP for every available distance matrix
#########################################################
permdisp_results_list <- list()
permdisp_sample_list <- list()
permdisp_model_list <- list()

for (distance_name in names(permdisp_distances)) {
  cat(
    "\nRunning PERMDISP for ",
    distance_name,
    "...\n",
    sep = "",
    file = LOGS_FILE,
    append = TRUE
  )

  analysis <- tryCatch(
    run_permdisp(
      distance_matrix = permdisp_distances[[distance_name]],
      distance_name = distance_name,
      metadata_df = permdisp_metadata,
      variable = PERMDISP_VARIABLE,
      permutations = PERMDISP_PERMUTATIONS,
      center = PERMDISP_CENTER,
      bias_adjust = PERMDISP_BIAS_ADJUST
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      cat(
        "ERROR for ",
        distance_name,
        ": ",
        conditionMessage(e),
        "\n",
        sep = "",
        file = LOGS_FILE,
        append = TRUE
      )

      warning(
        paste(
          "Skipping",
          distance_name,
          ":",
          conditionMessage(e)
        )
      )

      NULL
    }
  )

  if (!is.null(analysis)) {
    result_key <- gsub(
      "[^A-Za-z0-9]+",
      "_",
      distance_name
    )

    permdisp_results_list[[result_key]] <-
      analysis$results

    permdisp_sample_list[[result_key]] <-
      analysis$dispersion_data

    permdisp_model_list[[result_key]] <-
      analysis$model

    cat("\nPERMDISP results:", distance_name, "\n")
    print(analysis$test)

    #Save individual result table.
    write.table(
      analysis$results,
      file = file.path(
        PERMDISP_TABLES_DIR,
        paste0("PERMDISP_", result_key, ".tsv")
      ),
      sep = "\t",
      quote = FALSE,
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    #Save individual model object.
    saveRDS(
      analysis$model,
      file = file.path(
        PERMDISP_TABLES_DIR,
        paste0("PERMDISP_", result_key, "_model.rds")
      )
    )
  }
}

if (length(permdisp_results_list) == 0) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "ERROR: No PERMDISP analyses completed successfully.",
      "Review warnings and the log."
    )
  )
}


#########################################################
### 6. Combine and save results
#########################################################
permdisp_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  permdisp_results_list
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Significance = dplyr::case_when(
      `Pr(>F)` < 0.001 ~ "***",
      `Pr(>F)` < 0.01  ~ "**",
      `Pr(>F)` < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    ),
    P_adjusted_Holm = p.adjust(
      `Pr(>F)`,
      method = "holm"
    ),
    Significant_Holm = P_adjusted_Holm < 0.05
  )

write.table(
  permdisp_results,
  file = file.path(
    PERMDISP_TABLES_DIR,
    "PERMDISP_results.tsv"
  ),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nCombined PERMDISP results:\n")
print(permdisp_results)

cat(
  "\nCombined PERMDISP results saved to:\n",
  file.path(
    PERMDISP_TABLES_DIR,
    "PERMDISP_results.tsv"
  ),
  "\n",
  file = LOGS_FILE,
  append = TRUE
)


#########################################################
### 7. Save sample-level dispersion values
#########################################################
permdisp_sample_distances <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  permdisp_sample_list
)

write.table(
  permdisp_sample_distances,
  file = file.path(
    PERMDISP_TABLES_DIR,
    "PERMDISP_sample_distances.tsv"
  ),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#########################################################
### 8. Logs
#########################################################
cat("PERMDISP completed successfully.\n",
  "Grouping variable: ",
  PERMDISP_VARIABLE,
  "\nPermutations: ",
  PERMDISP_PERMUTATIONS,
  "\nResults: ",
  file.path(PERMDISP_TABLES_DIR, "PERMDISP_results.tsv"),
"\n", sep = "",
file = LOGS_FILE,nappend = TRUE)

cat("FINISHED STEP 5.C.2) PERMDISP.\n",
file = LOGS_FILE, append = TRUE)
```

```{r}
cat(paste0("STEP A) Plotting PERMDISP F-statistic by ", GROUPING_VAR, ".\n"),
file = LOGS_FILE, append = TRUE)


#########################################################
### 1. Define plotting configuration
#########################################################
PLOT_PERMDISP_VARIABLE <- GROUPING_VAR


#########################################################
### 2. Load combined PERMDISP results
#########################################################
PERMDISP_RESULTS_FILE <- file.path(
  OUTPUT_DIR,
  "PERMDISP",
  "tables",
  "PERMDISP_results.tsv")

if (!file.exists(PERMDISP_RESULTS_FILE)) {
  stop(
    "PERMDISP results file not found: ",

permdisp_results <- read.delim(
  PERMDISP_RESULTS_FILE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE

#########################################################
### 3. Keep results for the active grouping variable
#########################################################
permdisp_plot_data <- permdisp_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Variable == PLOT_PERMDISP_VARIABLE,
    !is.na(F),
    !is.na(`Pr(>F)`)
  )

if (nrow(permdisp_plot_data) == 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "No valid PERMDISP results found for ",
      PLOT_PERMDISP_VARIABLE,
      ". Check the Variable, F, and Pr(>F) columns."
    )
  )
}


#########################################################
### 4. Define plotting order and significance
#########################################################
distance_order <- c(
  "Bray-Curtis (Genus)",
  "Bray-Curtis (ASV)",
  "Jaccard (Genus)",
  "Jaccard (ASV)",
  "Weighted UniFrac (ASV)",
  "Unweighted UniFrac (ASV)"
)

observed_distances <- unique(
  permdisp_plot_data$Distance
)

distance_levels <- c(
  distance_order[distance_order %in% observed_distances],
  setdiff(observed_distances, distance_order)
)

permdisp_plot_data <- permdisp_plot_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Distance = factor(
      Distance,
      levels = distance_levels
    ),
    Significance = dplyr::case_when(
      `Pr(>F)` < 0.001 ~ "***",
      `Pr(>F)` < 0.01  ~ "**",
      `Pr(>F)` < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    ),
    P_value_label = paste0(
      "p = ",
      format.pval(
        `Pr(>F)`,
        digits = 3,
        eps = 0.001
      )
    ),
    Plot_label = paste0(
      Significance,
      "\n",
      P_value_label
    )
  )


#########################################################
### 5. Create PERMDISP F-statistic plot

) +

### 6. Display plot
```

## 6.1) ANCOM-B2
```{r}
cat("STEP 6.1) Running ANCOM-BC2 differential abundance analysis.\n", 
file = LOGS_FILE, append = TRUE)


#########################################################
### 0. Define ANCOM configuration
#########################################################
#Define ANCOM variables using project standards.
ANCOM_VAR <- GROUPING_VAR
ANCOM_COVARIATES <- COVARIATES

#Choose analysis level: "genus" or "asv" (change here!!!).
#To be honest it only makes sense for genus label because at ASV it breaks. 
TAXA_LEVEL <- "genus"  

if (TAXA_LEVEL == "genus") {
  feature_table <- genus_table_raw[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  rownames(feature_table) <- genus_table_raw[[1]]
} else {
  feature_table <- asv_table_raw[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  rownames(feature_table) <- asv_table_raw[[1]]
}

#Load count table and metadata.
#Note: BIOM-exported TSVs from QIIME2 often have a comment header line starting with #
metadata <- read.delim(
  MASTER_SAMPLE_SUMMARY,
  header = TRUE,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)

#Ensure sample IDs match between table and metadata.
common_samples <- intersect(colnames(feature_table), rownames(metadata))
feature_table <- feature_table[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
metadata <- metadata[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

#Build fixed effects formula dynamically.
ancom_fix_vars <- unique(c(ANCOM_VAR, ANCOM_COVARIATES))
fix_formula_str <- paste(ancom_fix_vars, collapse = " + ")


#########################################################
### 1. Run ANCOM-BC2.
#########################################################
output_ancombc2 <- ANCOMBC::ancombc2(
  data = feature_table,
  assay_name = NULL,
  tax_level = NULL,
  meta_data = metadata,
  fix_formula = fix_formula_str,
  rand_formula = NULL,
  p_adj_method = "bonferroni",
  prv_cut = 0.10,
  lib_cut = 0,
  s0_perc = 0.05,
  group = ANCOM_VAR,
  struc_zero = TRUE,
  neg_lb = TRUE,
  alpha = 0.05,
  n_cl = 4,
  verbose = TRUE,
  global = TRUE,
  pairwise = TRUE,
  dunnet = FALSE,
  trend = FALSE
)

#Save ANCOM-BC2 results.
ancombc2_res <- output_ancombc2$res
write.csv(
  ancombc2_res,
  file.path(
    TABLES_DIR,
    paste0("ANCOMBC2_results_", TAXA_LEVEL, ".csv")
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#########################################################
### 2. Logs
#########################################################
cat("FINISHED STEP 6.1) Running ANCOM-BC2 differential abundance analysis.\n",
file = LOGS_FILE, append = TRUE)
```

### 6.1.1) Visualizing ANCOM-B2 results with a log fold-change plot.
```{r}
#First check the structure and column names to see which columns we need!!
names(ancombc2_res)

str(ancombc2_res)
```
After checking the results:
lfc_sexmale: log fold change for the sexmale coefficient.
diff_sexmale: differential-abundance significance indicator.
q_sexmale: adjusted p-value (q-value).
diff_robust_sexmale: robust differential-abundance indicator.


```{r}
cat("STEP 6.1.1) Visualizing ANCOM-BC2 results with a log fold-change plot.\n",
file = LOGS_FILE, append = TRUE)


#Check diff_group and lfc_group! These will change depending on which 
# variable you are grouping by. 

#Filter significant taxa associated with sex with adjusted p-value below 0.05. 
res_df <- ancombc2_res %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(q_sexmale),
    q_sexmale < 0.05,
    !is.na(lfc_sexmale))

if (nrow(res_df) > 0) {

  #Extract shorter taxon names based on TAXA_LEVEL
  # taxonomy format example: d__Bacteria;...;f__Comamonadaceae
  tax_level_prefix <- switch(
    tolower(TAXA_LEVEL),
    "domain"  = "d__",
    "kingdom" = "k__",
    "phylum"  = "p__",
    "class"   = "c__",
    "order"   = "o__",
    "family"  = "f__",
    "genus"   = "g__",
    "species" = "s__",
    stop("Unrecognized TAXA_LEVEL: ", TAXA_LEVEL))

#Taxonomic ranks ordered from most specific to least specific
rank_order <- c("s__", "g__", "f__", "o__", "c__", "p__", "k__", "d__")

#Start with the selected rank, then try progressively higher ranks
start_rank <- match(tax_level_prefix, rank_order)

fallback_ranks <- rank_order[start_rank:length(rank_order)]

res_df <- res_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    taxon_label = vapply(
      strsplit(as.character(taxon), ";", fixed = TRUE),
      function(taxonomy) {

        taxonomy <- trimws(taxonomy)
        for (rank in fallback_ranks) {
          match <- taxonomy[
            startsWith(taxonomy, rank)]

          if (length(match) > 0) {
            label <- trimws(sub(
              paste0("^", rank),
              "",
              match[1]))

            #Skip empty and unclassified values (incertae sedis reveals 
            # no information so we also fall back)
            if (
              nzchar(label) &&
              !grepl(
                "^(unclassified|uncultured|unknown|na|none|incertae[_ ]sedis)$",
                label,
                ignore.case = TRUE)
            ) {
              return(paste0(rank, label))}}}

        #Fallback if no usable classification exists
        "Unclassified"
      },
      character(1)))

  #Create the log fold-change plot
  ANCOM_B2_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    res_df,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = reorder(taxon_label, lfc_sexmale),
      y = lfc_sexmale,
      fill = lfc_sexmale > 0)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    ggplot2::coord_flip() +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0(
        "ANCOM-BC2 Differential Abundance (",
        toupper(TAXA_LEVEL), ")"),
      
      #PLEASE! IMPORTANT! Do not forget to change sex here for whatever 
      # variable you are using.
      subtitle = "Significant taxa associated with sex",
      x = "Taxon",
      y = "Log Fold Change"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "TRUE" = "#D55E00",
        "FALSE" = "#0072B2")
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 12
      ),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(10, 15, 10, 15))

  #Save the plot
  plot_path <- file.path(
    FIGURES_DIR,
    paste0("ANCOMBC2_plot_", TAXA_LEVEL, ".png"))

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = plot_path,
    plot = ANCOM_B2_plot,
    width = 10,
    height = max(6, nrow(res_df) * 0.30),
    units = "in",
    dpi = 300,
    limitsize = FALSE)

  cat(paste0("ANCOM-BC2 plot saved successfully: ", plot_path, "\n"),
  file = LOGS_FILE, append = TRUE)

} else {
  cat(paste0("No significant taxa found for ", GROUPING_VAR, "to plot.\n"),
  file = LOGS_FILE,append = TRUE)}


cat("FINISHED STEP 6.1.1) Visualizing ANCOM-BC2 results with a log fold-change plot.\n", 
file = LOGS_FILE, append = TRUE)
```

### 6.1.2) Display the plot.
```{r}
cat("STEP 6.1.2) Displaying ANCOM-BC2 plot.\n",
file = LOGS_FILE, append = TRUE)


print(ANCOM_B2_plot)


cat("FINISHED STEP 6.1.2) Displaying ANCOM-BC2 plot.\n",
file = LOGS_FILE, append = TRUE)
```
